## Summary

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Mention API, proxy,
accessibility, deployment or security implications when relevant.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and link the GitHub Actions results. Mark irrelevant
checks as such; do not imply full test coverage from a local-only result.

- [ ] Applicable checks from [TESTING.md](../TESTING.md) passed.
- [ ] Code/configuration: regression tests, lint/coverage, build and applicable browsers/visuals.
- [ ] Markdown-only: lightweight documentation/CI-selection checks and build/`--check`.
- [ ] README/TECHNICAL/API/CHANGELOG updated where behavior changes.
- [ ] No credentials, personal payloads, runtime SQLite data or generated artifacts included.

## Notes

Mention remaining limitations or checks that could not be run.
